module RpcMetadata;

namespace sample
{
    enum State { Off = 0, On = 1, }
    flag enum Options { None = 0, First = 1, Second = 2, }
    struct Item { name : ::system::String; state : ::sample::State; }
    struct Envelope { note : ::system::String?; nested : ::sample::Item[][::system::String]; }
    struct NumericBoundaries { u8 : ::system::UInt8; i64 : ::system::Int64; single : ::system::Single; }

    @rpc:Interface
    @rpc:IdString("sample::ICallback")
    @rpc:IdNumber(20)
    interface ICallback
    {
        @rpc:IdString("sample::ICallback.Accept")
        @rpc:IdNumber(21)
        func Accept(value : ::sample::Envelope) : (::system::String);
    }

    @rpc:Interface
    @rpc:IdString("sample::IBase")
    @rpc:IdNumber(10)
    interface IBase
    {
        @rpc:Dynamic
        prop Name : ::system::String{GetName}

        @rpc:IdString("sample::IBase.GetName")
        @rpc:IdNumber(11)
        func GetName() : (::system::String);
    }

    @rpc:Interface
    @rpc:Ctor
    @rpc:IdString("sample::IService")
    @rpc:IdNumber(0)
    interface IService : ::sample::IBase, ::sample::ICallback
    {
        @rpc:Cached
        prop Items : observe ::sample::Item[]{GetItems, SetItems : ItemsChanged}

        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.ItemsChanged")
        @rpc:IdNumber(5)
        event ItemsChanged(::system::Int32, observe ::sample::Item[]);

        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.Convert(value).1")
        @rpc:IdNumber(1)
        func Convert(value : ::system::String) : (::system::String);

        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.Convert(value).2")
        @rpc:IdNumber(2)
        func Convert(value : ::system::Int32) : (::system::String);

        @rpc:Byref
        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.GetItems")
        @rpc:IdNumber(3)
        func GetItems() : (observe ::sample::Item[]);

        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.SetItems")
        @rpc:IdNumber(4)
        func SetItems(@rpc:Byref <value> : observe ::sample::Item[]) : (::system::Void);

        @rpc:Byval
        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.Snapshot")
        @rpc:IdNumber(6)
        func Snapshot(@rpc:Byref values : ::sample::Item[]) : (::sample::Item[]);

        @rpc:Byval
        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.RoundValueValue")
        @rpc:IdNumber(7)
        func RoundValueValue(@rpc:Byval values : ::sample::Item[]) : (::sample::Item[]);

        @rpc:Byref
        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.RoundValueReference")
        @rpc:IdNumber(8)
        func RoundValueReference(@rpc:Byval values : ::sample::Item[]) : (::sample::Item[]);

        @rpc:Byval
        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.RoundReferenceValue")
        @rpc:IdNumber(9)
        func RoundReferenceValue(@rpc:Byref values : ::sample::Item[]) : (::sample::Item[]);

        @rpc:IdString("sample::IService.UseCallback")
        @rpc:IdNumber(12)
        func UseCallback(callback : ::sample::ICallback^) : (::system::String);
    }
}
